figures.finding: Kazakhstan pays a subsidy (rebate) of up to 30% of the cost of goods, works and services for a film made there, including hiring actors and crew, through the State Center for Support of National Film (Kazakh Cinema), which is also the single operator of state financing for national film projects.

value.scheme: Subsidy in the field of cinematography (rebate), Law on Cinematography 2019
value.operator: State Center for Support of National Film (Kazakh Cinema)
value.base: goods, works and services related to film production in Kazakhstan (incl. actors and crew)

figures.applies: Kazakhstan, film productions (the rebate is aimed at foreign productions), 2026; caps and thresholds not read.

figures.finding: The 30% rebate for foreign productions, run by the State Centre for Support of National Cinema, drew no application from 2019 to 2025 and was never paid, the Ministry of Culture and Information's Committee of Culture says; the ministry is drafting amendments to pay rebates from local executive (akimat) budgets and simplify the procedure. No single filming permit exists (akimat consent for public places).

value.reform: amendments drafted: rebates from local executive budgets, simpler procedure

figures.applies: Kazakhstan; 2019 to 2025, as the Committee of Culture told NewTimes.kz.

sources.said: Казахстан с 2019 по 2025 годы предлагал иностранным кинокомпаниям компенсировать до 30% расходов на съемки фильмов в стране. Однако за все время действия программы ни одной заявки от зарубежных компаний так и не поступило, сообщили в Комитете культуры Министерства культуры и информации РК … Ведомство прорабатывает поправки в закон, согласно которым рибейты могут начать выплачивать из бюджетов местных исполнительных органов. … Не существует и единого разрешения на съемки иностранных фильмов в Казахстане.
